name: human-internal-writing
description: Route evidence-led writing through reusable editorial, enterprise-source, image, and verified Docs workflows, with a fail-closed public GitHub boundary.

interface.shortDescription: Route evidence-led writing through safe editorial and enterprise connectors.
interface.longDescription: Transform source material into restrained internal articles, technical long-form, and coherent Index/Hub pages with explicit edit, expansion, and audit modes; claim-to-evidence mapping; baseline-aware review; and reproducible technical evidence, then preserve hash-bound Markdown and publish an authorized A3 company Docs version with style, structure, and remote readback verification. DOCX/WPS remains opt-in.
defaultPrompt: Turn these meeting notes into a restrained internal article.
Preserve my viewpoint while removing generic AI phrasing.
Shorten this article without deleting the source-backed scene, mechanism, counterforce, or next proof that carries its central judgment.
Revise only the affected claims and sections while rechecking mutable, unversioned, or stale evidence from the prior version.
Revise this article section by section, showing changed Claim IDs, source readback, new connective reasoning, and decisions that need my approval.
Cold-read this team letter and strengthen its action path.
Audit this article Index/Hub for global coherence and reader entry clarity before changing its visual style.
Review this technical article for claim traceability and reproducibility before revising it.
Package this article as Markdown and a company Docs release with reproducible style, structure, and remote readback evidence.
When explicitly requested, add a verified DOCX/WPS package without weakening the Markdown and Docs gates.
Classify this writing task and route it through the correct Kim, Docs, editorial, and publication Skills.
Prepare a clean public GitHub export without carrying enterprise data, credentials, or internal links.
